**Affected Versions (Vendor Evidence):**
- Portable OpenSSH versions 8.5p1 through 9.7p1 (inclusive)

**Fixed Release (Vendor Evidence):**
- OpenSSH 9.8 / 9.8p1 (released July 1, 2024)

**Original Source URLs:**
- https://www.openssh.com/security.html
- https://www.openssh.com/txt/release-9.8

**Vendor Evidence Summary:**
The OpenSSH security page explicitly states: "July 1, 2024 sshd(8) in Portable OpenSSH versions 8.5p1 to 9.7p1 (inclusive). Race condition resulting in potential remote code execution. A race condition in sshd(8) could allow remote code execution as root on non-OpenBSD systems."

The release-9.8 notes confirm this is the fix version: "A critical vulnerability in sshd(8) was present in Portable OpenSSH versions between 8.5p1 and 9.7p1 (inclusive) that may allow arbitrary code execution with root privileges."

**Inference (Not Direct Vendor Statement):**
The CVE identifier itself is not present on these pages but can be inferred from the Qualys Security Advisory Team attribution (same researcher team that discovered the vulnerability) and the timeline matching the July 1, 2024 release date.
